entities.summary: Ottoman, a notable figure in the history of Yemen, associated with Ottoman and European Intrusions (1507–1636). Preceded by Coffee Trade and Mocha. Their legacy influenced Ottomans conquer Aden and coastal Yemen and Zaidi Imam al-Mu'ayyad Muhammad expels the Ottomans from Yemen.
